Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complanits of right shoulder pain and restricted range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the injury described and is plausible for a collision of this type. Over
four visits, care included passive and active range-of-motion exercises, a home exercise program, and monitoring of pain levels.
Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, reflecting a gradual rather than rapid response.
Examination showed reduced abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff, which support the reported injury. Other findings,
including neurovascular status and strength testing in the upper extremity, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the right
shoulder is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for these four visits show no repeated charges for the same services.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
